question: What lineage and supreme qualities define Rāma in this praise?
premises: Rāma is a descendant of Kakutstha and son of Kausalyā
He is the supreme, perfect person and best of the Raghus
inference: Rāma unites royal lineage with supreme and perfect divine nature
plain_english: The descendant of Kakutstha, the supreme person, perfect, son of Kausalyā, the best of the Raghus.
